title: Titan X Blueberry Sour Razz Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: The Titan X Refill Kit in Blueberry Sour Razz is designed for use with the Titan X Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. This refill pack contains a 2ml prefilled mouthpiece pod and three 5ml flavour-matched auto-refill capsules, offering consistent, flavourful vaping with no messy refilling. Just click the pod and capsules into place on your Titan X device and you’re ready to go. Blueberry Sour Razz blends the deep, jammy sweetness of ripe Blueberries with the bright, tart kick of Sour Raspberry. This vibrant fruit pairing delivers a rich, tangy vape experience with a layered flavour profile, balanced by a smooth nicotine salt formulation for a comfortable mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape and rapid nicotine relief. Complete with a pre-installed mesh coil for optimum flavour clarity and vapour production, the Titan X Refill Kit works seamlessly with the Titan X’s smart auto-refill technology to offer up to approximately 10,000 puffs per refill cycle (usage-dependent).
